title: Bounded-below derived direct image has quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and let $a\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $H^j(E)=0$ for all $j<a$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Then $H^q(Rf_*E)$ is quasi-coherent for every $q\in\mathbf Z$, equivalently $Rf_*E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$, where $Rf_*$ is [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Choose a strictly bounded-below representative of $E$ using the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to module direct image. Its bounded-below derived functor agrees with $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], since both are computed by an injective (hence K-injective) resolution of a bounded-below representative. The E2 terms are $R^p f_*H^j(E)$.
Clause (1) of [lem-pc-finite-support-hi] makes every E2 term quasi-coherent. Negative first-index terms and terms with $j<a$ vanish by the quadrant bound in [thm-sp-truncation-e2].

Induct on the page number. A next-page term is the kernel of its outgoing differential modulo the image of its incoming differential. The kernel and cokernel/image closure lemmas [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel] and [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image] make it quasi-coherent. Transfer these categorical constructions across the equivalence between Scheme.Modules and the shared SheafOfModules category if their category instances differ. Thus every stable term is quasi-coherent.

For each integer $q$, [thm-sp-truncation-e2] gives a finite filtration of $H^q(Rf_*E)$, full at first index zero and zero beyond $q-a$. Every graded piece is a stable page term, by the convergence comparisons. The zero final step is quasi-coherent (it is locally free on the empty set of generators). Descend through the finite number of steps, applying [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension] to $0\to F^{p+1}\to F^p\to\operatorname{gr}^p\to0$. The full step is quasi-coherent, as required for each $q$.

theorem schemeDerivedDirectImage_preserves_QCoh_of_isGE
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (a : ℤ) [E.IsGE a] :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)
